# graviteeam_i18n_dictionary (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM I18n Dictionary for login page translations

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_i18n_dictionary" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name      = "French"
  locale    = "fr"
  entries = {
    "login.title"    = "Connexion"
    "login.username" = "Identifiant"
    "login.password" = "Mot de passe"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain
- `locale` (String) The locale (e.g. en, fr, de)
- `name` (String) The name of the dictionary

### Optional

- `entries` (Map of String) Translation key-value pairs

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the dictionary
